reviews.review:
Lot of bugs
Ranger = Blow everything up
Air Raider = Blow everything up
Fencer = Blow everything up
Wing Diver = Blow everything up

Bugs go BOOM
10/10 would go BOOM again
stupidly amazing shooter, make sure to have volume at max to hear dialogue

If you like third person shooters with huge numbers of enemies and challenge, give this game a shot.  There's a balance between realism and fun, and EDF always goes with what's more fun.  Want huge battles with hundreds of allies and enemies launching huge AOE attacks and explosions?  Want to be able to have guns that can blow up entire city blocks?  Want to drive a mech that can punch a 100 meter tall monster in the face?  You can do all of these.  Now, you're not going to have state of the art AI for all the enemies, or the best building destruction animations, etc, but if you enjoy blasting enormous hordes of alien bugs and aliens you'll have a blast.  

The story and missions are good too.  Missions are varied, and there's a strong B-movie vibe to the story.  Not a 'so bad its good' type of thing, but a carefully crafted story that doesn't get in the way or go too deep, but has incredibly funny dialogue.  Some of the humor is due to basically random comments between your NPC allies, but most of it is from the main cast of allies you're listening to throughout.  Things like overly earnest or enthusiastic allies (played up as such) who can't figure out what a bug or frog alien looks like (which they're shooting at) to intentionally ridiculous dialogue (a command who's constantly saying "WHAT???" cracked me up more times than such a joke should).  

Combat and progression is a lot of fun.  Mission too hard?  Turn down the difficulty or replay the mission.  You can always come back with more powerful weapons (which slowly upgrade as you find drops).  Missions too easy?  Turn up the difficulty or try playing solo online (where monsters have increased health and damage).  You can play solo or with a group of 4.  And there's 4 classes to choose from, with over 100 missions that are pretty varied in objectives.  They do reuse maps, but the maps are something like 2x2 km, with varied starting locations and objectives, so it doesn't feel tedious.  

For the price and fun factor, a definite recommend.
